info.description: Estimator evidence, controlled workbook generation, and read-only operational intelligence for conversational agents.
info.title: Spray-Tec Business Intelligence API

post.description: Returns a read-only evidence package for Copilot reasoning. This operation does not call an LLM or create an estimate.
post.summary: Retrieve estimator evidence and deterministic context

post.description: Profiles the selected roofing, insulation, or flooring template, creates and recalculates a draft, validates required cost outputs, and returns a short-lived download link. This consequential operation requires confirmed=true and does not call an LLM or upload to SharePoint.
post.summary: Create an estimate workbook after estimator confirmation

post.description: Creates one independently recalculated and validated workbook for each complete option. Use for alternate warranties, areas, systems, or scope packages. The operation is atomic, requires confirmed=true, does not call an LLM, and does not upload files to SharePoint.
post.summary: Create estimate workbooks for multiple approved options

post.description: Returns a bounded list of jobs and operational attention signals. Use the returned stable job_id with getJobContext for detail.

get.description: Returns read-only job-board, workflow, schedule, tracking, document, and bounded office-activity evidence for an authoritative job_id.
get.summary: Retrieve complete operational context for one job

post.description: Returns complete bounded-date rollups by employee, work code, project label, and day, plus recent source entries and timesheet links. Activity-only touches remain distinct from captured hours. This operation is read-only.

Returns read-only office activity rollups by project label, including captured hours, milestones, next actions, stalled-work signals, and explicitly qualified authoritative or inferred job links. Progress means activity evidence, not percent complete.
post.summary: Summarize office work progress by project and qualified job link

post.description: Returns current contracted backlog totals, readiness and division rollups, prioritized blockers, and source folders. This operation is read-only.

Returns read-only production-plan cost proxies by job and budget bucket. Tracked quantities and hours are valued with estimate-derived rates. The results are not accounting actual costs, percent complete, or realized profitability.
post.summary: Compare tracked production usage with estimate-derived budgets

post.description: Returns a bounded schedule window or the active production-risk queue with crew, schedule health, project health, and tracking signals. This operation is read-only.
post.summary: Retrieve schedule workload and production risks

post.description: Reuses the authoritative sales, operations, office, or production-budget service and returns a normalized chart specification with bounded rows. The operation is read-only and does not generate narrative conclusions.
Returns the same normalized chart dataset as a CSV file for ChatGPT Data Analysis. The operation is read-only.
post.summary: Download a chart-ready business dataset as CSV

post.description: Returns a bounded, prioritized follow-up queue with ownership, due-state, data-quality issues, opportunity value, and source links. This operation is read-only.
post.summary: Retrieve the proposed-job sales follow-up queue

post.description: Returns bounded pipeline totals, stage and owner rollups, top opportunities, attention items, and source links. This operation is read-only.
